title: Constant prime coefficients extended by zero on reduced curves
statement: Let k be algebraically closed [def-weil-algebraic-closure], X a reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme] separated finite-type k-scheme of dimension at most one [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting], j:U -> X an open immersion, and r a prime. Put R = ULift(Z/rZ), with its canonical module structure. The extension by zero [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero] of the constant R-module sheaf R on U satisfies all eight conditional curve assertions [def-weil-pbc-eight-curve-assertions]. The sheaves and their constructibility are read in the module-valued convention [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]; X and U may be empty and X need not be proper.

proof.text: Split a smooth curve into finitely many open-and-closed irreducible components: smooth local rings are normal domains; Noetherianity makes the complement of a component closed. Apply the smooth constant Kummer or Artin--Schreier assertions, including the zero-dimensional cases. For each component the intersection with U is empty or dense, so dense-open localization yields its lower-shriek assertions. Finite pushforward and short-exact devissage assemble the finite direct sum. The smooth assertion packages use the smooth constant curve computations [thm-sc-main], preserving the unit's curve-calculation step.

Choose the finite smooth modification of the reduced curve, isomorphic over a dense open D. Apply the smooth case to the pullback of j, then finite pushforward. Both sheaves are constructible and killed by r, and their restrictions to D agree. Dense-open localization twice transfers the assertions to j_! R. Forgetting the canonical prime-field module structure preserves the relevant sheaves, stalk formulas and comparison maps.

proof_origin: Stacks 03SG and 0A3Q: smooth constant calculations, finite smooth modification and comparison on a dense open; module-valued transport is described in the docstring.

theorem reducedConstantLowerShriekAssertions {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    {X U : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsCurve f] [IsReduced X]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] (r : ℕ) [Fact r.Prime] :
    IsCurve.Assertions (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)) f
      ((Etale.openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r))) j).obj
        ((constantSheaf U.smallEtaleTopology
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)))).obj
          (ModuleCat.of _ (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)))))
